info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Corporate Billing Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of corporate billing reviews for enterprises, ensuring streamlined billing management. Users can submit reviews related to billing operations through a defined endpoint, allowing for efficient tracking and processing. This service is essential for finance teams and billing administrators looking to maintain accurate and up-to-date billing records. Typical consumers of this API include account managers and financial analysts who require robust review capabilities within their billing processes.
